content.help: Auto uses the body that has presets installed; if both do, Fusion Girl. Applies on next game start.
Skips Fusion-Athletic, Curvy, Petite, SeveNBase and VanillaEsque, so only presets you installed are used. Applies on next game start.

content.text: Ignore stock True Wasteland Body presets
content.help: Skips the presets shipped with True Wasteland Body. Applies on next game start.
Skips presets with cloth, outfit, nevernude, bikini, feet, hands, push, cleavage or armor in the name. Applies on next game start.
Clothed actors get ORefit changes on top of their body (push-up, smoother shapes), undone exactly when they undress. Outfits can be excluded with JSON files in Data\F4SE\Plugins\OBodyFO4.
Also applies ORefit to your character. It only adds its own changes on top of your body and undoes exactly those when you undress, so a body made by hand in LooksMenu is kept.
Opens the preset list for the NPC under your crosshair, or for yourself if there is none.
